title: Register with the portable long service scheme (cleaning, security)
what: Register with the state's portable long service scheme and report eligible workers' service.

laws.title: Contract Cleaning Industry (Portable Long Service Leave Scheme) Act 2010 (NSW)

sources.title: Contract Cleaning Industry (Portable Long Service Leave Scheme) Act 2010 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: (2) An employer for the contract cleaning industry must apply to the Corporation for registration as an employer not later than the end of— (a) the prescribed period for the employer, or (b) such additional time as the Corporation allows.

sources.title: Contract cleaning industry employer registration long service leave
sources.publisher: Australian Business Licence and Information Service (ABLIS)
sources.quote: You must apply for this registration if you operate a contract cleaning business and employ workers to perform cleaning work (on wages or salary).

confidence_note: Quoted from the law's current text on 10 Nov 2026, replacing the ABLIS-first draft (methods rule 5a); the ABLIS listing stays as a reach source.

assessment.summary: Employers must register with the industry's portable long service leave scheme, report workers' service and pay a levy.

marks.reason: Workers keep their long service entitlement when they move between employers in the industry.
Registration, quarterly service returns and the levy.
